description: After you edit UI code, check it against this repository's design system before you finish. Returns every hardcoded color, spacing, font, radius or shadow that should be a token, with the token to use. When an issue has an `edit`, replace line `edit.line` (currently `edit.before`) with `edit.after` exactly; it is a verified one-line swap. Pass the files you edited to check only those (fast); omit files to check the whole repository. Re-run until it reports no issues.

files.description: Repository-relative or absolute paths to limit the check to

name: check_ui_against_design_system
title: Check UI code against the design system
